name: sidecal
description: Let Claude read and time-block your Apple Calendar through SideCal, a local MCP server. No network.
long_description: SideCal must be installed in Applications and opened once, with calendar access allowed. Claude can then list your calendars, read events, add events and move or rename them. It cannot delete events, and events you hide in SideCal stay hidden from Claude.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List the calendars shown in SideCal.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Move, resize or rename an event.
